themes: The reward described in the Quran
summary_for_children: Surah Muhammad speaks of believers and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and describes rivers promised to the righteous. We only learn about them from the Quran.
environment_concept: A reading stand with the ayah that describes rivers (47:15; the rivers themselves are not pictured), a quiet garden and stepping stones for steady feet (47:7).
architecture_and_scenery: Abstract channels of light labelled by the ayah: water unaltered, milk, honey; a calm garden edge.

areas.name: Rivers Described
areas.description: Four abstract streams of light, each labelled with the ayah; symbolic only.

activities.name: Read the description
activities.description: Read 47:15 and match each stream label; no picture of Paradise is claimed.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Good deeds
activities.description: Lay five numbered stones in order: feet planted firmly.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration explicitly says the unseen is known only through the Quran.
learning_objectives: Explain helping Allah's cause by good deeds

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (lectern, orchard, spring) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A walled garden of this world on a slope, with a spring at the top and four stone channels to four pools

primary_mechanic.text: Take the right tool from the rack (rake for leaves, lever bar for stones, scoop for mud) and clear each of four channels from the spring down; the water runs on as far as the next block, and a pool turns clear when its channel runs all the way. The Garden of 47:15 is read only, never pictured.

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the gate, four channels to clear, then two readings in the garden
world_assets: tool rack with rake, lever bar and scoop
leaves, stones and mud blocking the channels
environment_behaviour: water runs down a channel as far as the first block
a pool turns from murky to clear when its channel runs
the chosen tool is carried in hand
unique_world.learning_objective: Reflect on the Quran (47:24) and on fresh, running water as a sign

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Path of Responsibility
story_library.children_narration: This surah addresses serious matters of conflict, faith, responsibility, and generosity. It also encourages people to think deeply about the Quran rather than ignoring its message. It reminds believers that worldly life is not the only thing that matters.

world_idea.title: The Garden of Reflection
world_idea.description: An age-appropriate learning environment centered on reflection, generosity, and responsible conduct. Historical conflict is explained through narration and contextual learning, not combat minigames.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Fighting passages are given only as context for older readers; there is no combat.
